supplements.method: Read-only: the `disassembly` field of the AMM package's `deposit` and `pool` modules at version 3 (digest Gxia3EZSdQeCXGPkmhXRzXWfmV6bnw7oRvSXNxNLQ9T1; `deposit` bytes hash to the sha256 pinned under modules.aftermath-deposit) and of the protocol-fee vault package's `vault` module at version 2 (current id 0xaead64e3b3cc7972ba86396df07066c90176f42c6aea53b6df0d8ab11007ece2, digest AFYbLCPpE7c8VyAbb5qQNoDsg5ruKA4hDZgZoQYYqkNT, bytes sha256 ba9bcf56e766b4d083428d7f29097d2f766f390db5558c3b0c5f4100e413a788). No transactions or dev-inspect fixtures executed.
supplements.why: The launchpad adapter (ADR 0116) creates a launch's Aftermath pool at creation from a seed and deposits the migration hand-off into it with `deposit_2_coins_direct`. These show the deposit rejects a zero coin, takes Aftermath's protocol fee from each coin through `protocol_fees::collect_fees_2_coins` before computing the LP out with `math::calc_deposit_exact_in_direct`, aborts with code 24 only when that LP is below the caller's minimum, joins both remaining coins whole (`pool::join` puts the whole coin into the pool balance), and mints the LP. The vault's `total_protocol_fee` is the rate `collect_fees` applies: `mul_by_fraction(amount, total_protocol_fee)` in the `1e18` fixed unit, then split among the treasury (50% at observation, less a 5% referee discount when the sender has a referrer), insurance fund (30%), and dev wallet (20%), so the take never exceeds that fraction. The pool constants show the 1,000-unit minimum LP supply locked at creation and the swap-in fee bounds (1e14 to 1e17).

supplements.method: Read-only `simulateTransaction` of `0xbc7b2c577ad9362fbb0dba397d17f3bcc81bf7aa916559f99a77eaee05d0947c::geometric_mean_calculations::calc_deposit_fixed_amounts_direct`, the function `amm::math::calc_deposit_exact_in_direct` calls for a flatness-0 pool, with the launch pool's terms (weights 5e17/5e17, swap-in fees 1e14, swap-out fees 0) and balances and amounts normalized by the 1e18 decimal scalars `pool::new_pool` assigns when no coin decimals are given (`supplements[1]`-era bytecode, `respect_decimals` false). Atomic amounts below are multiplied by 1e18 before the call. No transactions executed.
supplements.why: ADR 0116's migration deposits the hand-off into the seeded pool. The exact-in deposit solves for the LP share with a Newton iteration in u256 fixed point and overflows `fixed::mul_down` when one coin's balance growth ratio dwarfs the other's. `deposit_grid` records, per seed, whether a single deposit growing Meme's balance by the first factor and Quote's by the second succeeded; success holds whenever the two growth ratios are within 100x of each other at every size tested, and fails otherwise. `slicing_plan` records the adapter's slicing rule (one-sided slices growing the skewed coin 100x alongside one atomic unit of the other until the rest is within the skew) checked slice by slice against the same math for edge and log-uniform random seeds and hand-offs up to u64::MAX; every slice succeeded, and the one plan failure is a hand-off of one Quote atom, which cannot fund the atoms the slices need.
